title: Schedule of Cancellation Charges, Meetings & Events Contracts
content:
Under every Meetings & Events package the cancellation charge is a percentage of the contract's estimated revenue, which for this purpose is the estimated food and beverage revenue and room rental. The percentage depends on how many calendar days before the event the signed cancellation is received. Each package's scale is read from the top: the first step whose day count is reached (the notice is received that many calendar days or more before the event) applies.

## Scale as contracted

| Package | Steps from the top: received at least this many calendar days before the event, percentage of estimated revenue |
|---|---|
| Executive Boardroom Package | 30 days: 0 percent; 8 days: 50 percent; 0 days: 100 percent |
| Half-Day Meeting Package | 60 days: 0 percent; 15 days: 50 percent; 0 days: 100 percent |
| Full-Day Meeting Package | 90 days: 0 percent; 31 days: 50 percent; 0 days: 100 percent |
| Social Reception Package | 180 days: 25 percent; 90 days: 50 percent; 30 days: 75 percent; 0 days: 100 percent |
| Wedding Celebration Package | 365 days: 25 percent; 180 days: 50 percent; 90 days: 75 percent; 0 days: 100 percent |
| Conference Plenary Package | 365 days: 25 percent; 180 days: 50 percent; 90 days: 75 percent; 0 days: 100 percent |

## The same scales as day bands

| Package | Band of calendar days before the event | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Executive Boardroom Package | 30 or more | 0 percent |
| | 8 to 29 | 50 percent |
| | 0 to 7 | 100 percent |
| Half-Day Meeting Package | 60 or more | 0 percent |
| | 15 to 59 | 50 percent |
| | 0 to 14 | 100 percent |
| Full-Day Meeting Package | 90 or more | 0 percent |
| | 31 to 89 | 50 percent |
| | 0 to 30 | 100 percent |
| Social Reception Package | 180 or more | 25 percent |
| | 90 to 179 | 50 percent |
| | 30 to 89 | 75 percent |
| | 0 to 29 | 100 percent |
| Wedding Celebration Package and Conference Plenary Package | 365 or more | 25 percent |
| | 180 to 364 | 50 percent |
| | 90 to 179 | 75 percent |
| | 0 to 89 | 100 percent |

## Points of reading

- The Executive Boardroom, Half-Day Meeting and Full-Day Meeting packages each have a step at which no charge applies; the Social Reception, Wedding Celebration and Conference Plenary packages charge at least 25 percent however early the cancellation is received.
- A day count that equals a step's figure belongs to that step. For the Full-Day Meeting Package, a notice received 31 calendar days before the event falls at 50 percent and one received 30 days before falls at 100 percent; at 90 days it falls at 0 percent and at 89 days at 50 percent.
- For the Social Reception Package, 180 days falls at 25 percent and 179 days at 50 percent.
